summary_1line: Rama kills the Shudra ascetic Shambuka for performing forbidden penance, after which the gods revive a dead Brahmin boy and praise Rama.

image_candidates.scene_text: Rama stands by a lonely mountain lake as the ascetic Shambuka hangs upside down in severe penance from a tree branch.
Rama draws his shining sword and beheads Shambuka while the ascetic still hangs upside down in meditation.
Celestial flowers rain from the sky as the gods appear above praising Rama after Shambuka’s death.
